items.text: Career guidance usually means giving information and direction about courses, careers and next steps, while career counselling is a more personal, structured conversation that helps a person explore their situation and decide, and in practice the terms overlap, so judge a service by what it actually does and what it promises.
Ask any service what it will do in each session, what qualifications its staff have and what it will not promise.
Good help explains options and leaves the decision with you.
